title: Savings Control Tower: unified signal-driven batching/caching/quantization initiative
creator: Connor Hayes
description: Objective: build a centralized control plane (Savings Control Tower) that ingests runtime signals and console telemetry to make automated, auditable recommendations and rollouts for batching, KV cache prefetch, and quantization profiles. The Control Tower will provide per-customer and per-route policies, an experimentation harness for A/Bing savings changes, and dashboards with clear economic and quality trade-offs. This initiative spans product, infra, and research: product defines policy surfaces and guardrails, infra exposes low-latency signals and rollout APIs, and research curates quantization/quality profiles and validation sets.
acceptance_criteria: Control Tower ingests token-level cost signals and per-route latency percentiles from Console within 60s of event
Automated recommendations endpoint returns a ranked list of batching/cache/quant changes with estimated $/token delta and projected latency impact
Canary rollout integration supports traffic split, rollback, and automated rollback on quality regression signals
Experimentation UI in Console displays live economic delta and quality metrics for active trials
Documented runbook and audit logs for every automated change (compliant with Private deployment audit requirements)
